reviews_h2: What people are saying about the HVAC

reviews.author: Keith Wagner & Mandi Williams
reviews.text: William Riley installed a new 2.5 ton unit at my house as my 15+ year unit bit the dust, he was extremely quick to respond when I called him and within 2 days he had the new system installed and running, very great service and extremely knowledgeable. I hope I never need to use him again but if so I will do with GREAT CONFIDENCE and will be recommending him to anyone that needs service including my Real Estate Clients through my business. Thanks Riley from Keith.

reviews.author: carol shepherd
reviews.text: I cannot express enough how grateful I am for the amazing service I received when my air conditioning suddenly stopped working in this ridiculous heat. Mr. Riley responded to my message quickly and was able to come out the same day.Not only did he quickly identify the problem, but had my a/c up and running in no time! I would highly recommend this company to anyone in need of air conditioning services. Thank you for saving us from the sweltering heat and providing such excellent service!

reviews.author: Herman G
reviews.text: All I have to say is, that Mr. Riley took care of the heating problem at one of our rental properties immediately. He was honest, professional, and reasonable for a last minute call. He provided us with photos of what was wrong and repaired them immediately without any nonsense, like these other expensive HVAC companies. Will definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Francesco Tran
reviews.text: Appomattox Heating and Air Conditioning (William) was amazing! He came on time as needed and provided us a quick quote on how much the work was going to cost. He provided us with deals that is incomparable to other HVAC business/companies. William installed a new AC and also fixed our air handler on the 2nd floor of the house super quick. We are super happy with his work. William is a good man and a very passionate business owner. I will come to him for all of my future HVAC issues/installs and will highly recommend him to anyone in the South Chesterfield or Chester area. Thank you sir!!

reviews.author: Dena Banks
reviews.text: I am so impressed with this company’s knowledge, quality, honesty and customer service. I had my AC unit relocated, line set moved behind the drywall, and all of the other fine details that go along with moving your unit. I will never call a different company. I highly recommend! Thank you, Will!

reviews.author: Allison Wright
reviews.text: I just wanted to say that Mr William Riley of Appomattox Heating and air is at top of his game. He is very prompt and informative and very skilled. I had a very old unsalvageable system over 20 years old and he was amazing to know what system and tonnage and how to rebuild my coil system in the inside split unit so beautifully it's much more efficient and runs smoother and so quiet I barely hear it cut on. It's a wonderful unit and worth all the hours and sweat he put into it because our lives are more comfortable and saner now. No more expensive bandaid fixes from companies that don't really know what's wrong to begin with. We thank Mr Riley for a job well done. He has my business from now on with anything that needs fixing with my systems. Awesome job couldn't have done it myself I'm glad I left it to the professional. Thanks a million again Appomattox Heating and Air for all you did to make it so cool again.

reviews.author: Sharon Sculthorpe
reviews.text: I couldn't be any happier than I am with the response and service I was provided today. My AC went out and I had no luck getting anyone to come help me. I called Appomattox and they immediately responded to my situation and were able to work me into their busy schedule and had me up and running within 30 minutes of their arrival. I am thrilled as my house was over 90° inside. They were very professional and reasonable and he even took time to show me some problem areas that need to be addressed. I will absolutely have them back to address those issues and to be my go to for any heating and air needs!

reviews.author: Cory Jones
reviews.text: Excellent work!!! I had a unit installed by Appomattox Heating & Air Conditioning and I am absolutely satisfied. That’s saying a lot coming from me because I am very picky of the work done to my house. Will is very knowledgeable and explained the install process in a way I can understand it. Price for the install was amazing. Appomattox Heating & Air Conditioning will not rob you blind. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Jessica H.
reviews.text: This is one of the best companies I've had the pleasure of dealing with! The service and professionalism is truly top notch. Will was super helpful and thorough in getting our ventilation system back up and running at work, and we can't operate without it. He absolutely saved the day! Plus the prices are super reasonable - you cannot beat this business!

reviews.author: Lex
reviews.text: Heat pump installed by this company. We needed him to come out for maintenance and temperature issues. William stated he would come the next day after we called which was great. He did not come at the scheduled time so we reached out to him and he stated he was with another client that took longer than normal. Which is okay, but a heads up would have been appreciated. He never called back to give any updates and my husband had to call AGAIN and he said he would come Sunday. Sunday arrives and he is not here at the scheduled time. My husband calls AGAIN, and he says it’s raining and he could not work in the rain, but we live in the same city so when the rain stopped he would come. Have not heard from him since. It is terribly unprofessional and a huge inconvenience as we made arrangements to be home waiting on his arrival. I do understand things come up, but he was just a flat out no call/no show. I would only recommend his service if you sit at all home all day with nothing to do and like to play phone tag. I see someone also had a similar experience, so I suppose we are not alone in this. Sad.

reviews.author: amy brazier
reviews.text: What a blessing this man was! He was prompt, courteous, extremely knowledgeable and very fair priced. As a single mom, managing the inner workings of owning your own home can be intimidating. Good to know there are still good, honest folks out there. He will definitely be my go to from here on out . Highly recommend!

reviews.author: D Banks
reviews.text: I am a repeat customer. With the hot July weather, my capacitor went out and left us without AC. Mr. Riley was able to diagnose the problem over the phone, showed up first thing that morning and confirmed my capacitor needed to be replaced. My unit was back up and running within 20 minutes.

reviews.author: Stef Yo
reviews.text: William was prompt and understood my urgency when my gas furnace stopped working. He took time out of his schedule to come take a look, and fixed my issue! I could not be more thankful and appreciative!

reviews.author: Page Thomas
reviews.text: Top notch company! This company saved us from a serious life and death situation, Professional, Responds immediately, efficient, more than fair pricing. So Knowledgeable . Honest. Forget the rest call the best!

reviews.author: Scott Lovelady
reviews.text: My AC quit working and I called Appomattox and he was here within 1 hour. My air was up and running in less than an hour. Highly recommended and they will be the only company I deal with

reviews.author: Viviana Negron Rivera
reviews.text: Unfortunately I couldn't meet him in person, but this gentleman deserves a shoutout!! Super courteous and polite.Fast service, efficient and great pricing! I totally recommend him!! Thanks Will!!!!!

reviews.author: Angel M
reviews.text: A late post on my part. Showed up on time and fixed the issue immediately. Returned to do additional service. A pleasure to deal with. Will be my only HVAC "go to" company for my home.

reviews.author: Thomas Sweeney
reviews.text: Will was able to get our old AC fixed and working like new in 12 hours. He is honest and dependable.

reviews.author: Audrey Jones
reviews.text: I had several estimates, and I highly recommend Appomattox Heating & Air! They are #1 in my book for QUALITY, VALUE AND SERVICE! Thank you all your assistance!

reviews.author: Jordan Heartwell
reviews.text: Great price and very helpful! Highly recommend! Thank you Will for a great service and for driving the long way!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Paradis
reviews.text: I am really happy with the service !!! They were able to help me the same day!!! I recommend this company!!!
